capturePitfalls: Avoid mixed display scale factors across takes
Keep screen and mic audio as separate tracks
Keep window chrome, theme, and zoom consistent
Capture real screen and voice timing together
Prioritize continuous source takes over stills
Hold at least two seconds after the payoff moment
Leave idle headroom before press and after return
Record at least two usable takes per beat
